headline: H.R. 549 would have let Venezuelan nationals qualify for temporary protected status, but the House voted it down on July 23, 2019.
what_it_does: The bill would have allowed Venezuelan nationals to qualify for temporary protected status. That status would have prevented their removal from the United States. It would also have let them obtain employment and travel authorization.

who_it_affects.group: Venezuelan nationals in the United States
who_it_affects.how: They would have been able to qualify for temporary protected status, which would protect them from removal and allow them to seek work and travel authorization.
